title: Very rough, thin and flimsey
text: Very rough, thin and flimsey. I was able to sand it down, restain it in all the places that were missing stain and put a nice coat of poly on it. Now it is almost as good as I was hoping, but it still is very flimsy and lightweight, not sure you could hang a heavy coat on it. I would not have bought if I had known about the quality. Not recommended.

product_metadata.title: Wall Mounted Coat Rack Shelf, Rustic Wooden Country Style 24" Entryway Shelf with 5 Rustic Hooks Featuring Solid Pine Wood. Perfect Touch for Your Entryway, Mudroom, Kitchen, Bathroom and More, Black

The 24" length is ideal for all areas. The 5 sturdy hooks and flat 3.75 inch shelf makes this rack perfect. Add a touch of rustic beauty to your entryway, hallway, kitchen, bedroom or anywhere else. Each coat rack comes with screws and anchors included making ready to hang out right out of the box!
